subject: Q1 EU billing: VAT evidence portal + invoice patch request
messages:
From: Aashish Rao <aashish@paygate.co>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Elise Tremblay <elise.t@eu-procurement.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: VAT certificate + request to reissue invoice without VAT

Hi Irene,

We're ready to move forward with Q1 usage but our finance team needs two things before release of payment: a copy of Redwood's VAT evidence addressing reverse-charge handling and a revised invoice that shows zero VAT with our VAT ID and the reverse-charge notation.

Details:
- PayGate Solutions Ltd (billing name): PayGate Solutions Ltd
- VAT ID: DE123456789
- Original Redwood invoice: 7382 (dated 2027-03-01)
- PO: PO-55612 (attached in our system)

Can you confirm you'll issue a credit for the taxed invoice and reissue with the reverse-charge line and our VAT ID? I've attached our VAT certificate for your records. Our AP team will process payment within 5 business days once the corrected invoice is sent to invoices@paygate.co.

Thanks,
Aashish
Aashish Rao
Senior Procurement Manager
PayGate Solutions
Attachment: paygate_vat_certificate.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Aashish Rao <aashish@paygate.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: VAT certificate + request to reissue invoice without VAT

Hi Aashish — thanks for sending the certificate and the PO reference.

Ben and Marcus — looping you in to confirm the billing entity and to action an invoice patch. High level ask:
- Issue a credit for invoice 7382 and reissue a corrected invoice with "Reverse-charge — VAT liable recipient" language, include PayGate's VAT ID (DE123456789), and set VAT amount to 0.
- Use billing name exactly: "PayGate Solutions Ltd" and send the corrected invoice to invoices@paygate.co and to Aashish.
- Please confirm ETA; AP needs the corrected invoice to clear payment within 5 business days.

Aashish, I'll follow up once finance confirms. If there are any required supporting fields for your AP system (tax codes, place-of-supply), let me know — happy to include.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:30:00 +0100
Subject: FW: VAT certificate + request to reissue invoice without VAT

Marcus — forwarding thread. Can you take the invoice change? Below are the specific actions requested by the customer and our proposed workflow.

Requested by customer:
- Credit invoice 7382 (grossed amount €12,450)
- Reissue invoice with net amount €12,450, VAT 0.00, annotation: "Reverse-charge — VAT liable recipient. VAT ID: DE123456789"
- Billing name: PayGate Solutions Ltd
- Send to invoices@paygate.co and copy Aashish

Proposed internal steps:
1) Create credit note CN-7382-1 referencing invoice 7382
2) Generate corrected invoice 7382-RC with the reverse-charge annotation and attach supporting certification we received from the customer (paygate_vat_certificate.pdf)
3) Update our AR ledger and mark the original invoice as replaced/voided for audit traceability
4) Notify customer and provide a PDF copy and a machine-readable XML summary for their AP system if needed

Attachments: redwood_invoice_7382_patch_1.pdf (draft with proposed annotation).

Marcus — ETA on step 1-2? If you want me to file the credit note draft I can do that today; otherwise please push into billing queue and set priority to high (payment hold).

Ben
Revenue Operations — Billing
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_invoice_7382_patch_1.pdf

Thanks Irene and Ben — that works for us.

Couple quick confirmations from AP: please put the legal name exactly as "PayGate Solutions Ltd" on the corrected invoice and include the PO number (PO-55612) in the invoice header. A PDF is fine; our system will accept an XML summary if you can provide it but not required.
